knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Soil shields micro-organisms and reduces the effect of the sanitiser.
The label sets the concentration and contact time.
Release belongs to the authorised person, and it is recorded.

practicalCriteria: Confirms the task type with the supervisor before starting.
Removes soil before applying sanitiser, and redoes the sequence if the order is wrong.
Uses the label concentration and full contact time with a timer.
passRule: Correct sequence, label concentration and full contact time observed, and release given only by the authorised person. Observed by an assessor. Not a food safety qualification.
stopWorkCriteria: Sanitiser applied over visible soil and not corrected
Concentration or contact time estimated rather than taken from the label
